$comment: PDF export (feature 014): the File > Export entry, the Save dialog's page sizes, the export's progress, messages and reasons. Feature catalogue merged by i18n/index.ts.

exportPdf.description: Write the book as a searchable PDF/A file in a page size you choose, with bookmarks, links, footnotes and the whole description in its metadata

pdf.exportDone: Exported to {{path}}: {{pages}} pages in {{size}}, {{pictures}} pictures, {{tables}} tables, {{notes}} notes.
pdf.exportCancelled: The export was cancelled; no file was written.
pdf.exportSummaryIntro: Not everything was carried over as written:

summary.pictureLeftOut: Picture {{detail}} left out: it has no data, or it is not a picture
summary.fontReplaced: Font “{{detail}}” replaced by the editor's own font of its kind
summary.systemFont: Drawn with a system font, as no font the editor ships has them: {{detail}}
summary.linkAsText: Link to {{detail}} written as text: nothing in the book has that id

reason.printFailed: the browser engine could not print the pages ({{message}})
reason.targetIsSource: the file chosen is the book itself, or the archive it was opened from
reason.badPageSize: the page size is not one of the nine
reason.ioError: the file could not be written ({{message}})
reason.checkFailed: the finished file failed its own check ({{message}})
reason.unknownToken: the export was no longer known to the core
reason.noPart: a part of the pages is missing
reason.tooManyPages: the book has more pages than a PDF the editor writes may have

limit.pages: the book would take {{count}} pages; a PDF the editor writes has at most {{max}}
limit.notes: the book has {{count}} notes; a PDF the editor writes holds at most {{max}}
